title: Opinion Essays and Arguments
description: Write persuasive paragraphs on thought-provoking topics with guiding questions and key linking words.

thumbnail.alt: A balance scale weighing a quill pen against a lightbulb symbolizing debate
thumbnail.prompt: A balance scale weighing a quill pen against a lightbulb symbolizing debate

cards.prompt: Write your opinion: Should students have homework on weekends?
followUps: What is the main benefit or disadvantage?
How does weekend rest affect student focus during the week?
What alternative study habit could replace homework?

cards.prompt: Write your opinion: Is social media making people more connected or more isolated?
followUps: How does online interaction differ from face-to-face conversation?
What psychological effects can excessive screen time cause?
What conclusion do you draw overall?

cards.prompt: Write your opinion: Should all cities provide free public transportation for their residents?
followUps: How would this impact traffic congestion and air pollution?
Who should pay for the maintenance of the transport system?
What challenges might public transit systems face?

cards.prompt: Write your opinion: Can artificial intelligence replace teachers in future classrooms?
followUps: Which aspects of teaching cannot be automated by computers?
How can AI tools support teachers rather than replace them?
What ethical considerations should schools keep in mind?

cards.prompt: Write your opinion: Should zoos exist in the modern world?
followUps: What role do reputable zoos play in endangered species conservation?
What ethical concerns arise when keeping wild animals in captivity?
Are virtual wildlife reserves a realistic alternative?

cards.prompt: Write your opinion: Does money buy happiness?
followUps: Up to what point does financial security increase life satisfaction?
What non-material factors are essential for genuine well-being?
How does spending money on experiences compare to buying material goods?
